description: Update the billing and shipping addresses of an eligible uncaptured Invoice transaction.

transaction_id.title: Transaction Id
transaction_id.description: The merchant transaction id of the target Invoice transaction

billing_address.description: Reuses the shared #billing address definition (all nine fields, ISO-3166 country enum, conditional US/CA state rules) and only layers the country-required rule on top.

shipping_address.description: Reuses the shared #billing address definition (all nine fields, ISO-3166 country enum, conditional US/CA state rules) and only layers the country-required rule on top.
